name: Soldier
description: Steady Aim applies Focused for one phase, setting up an accurate attack.

techniques.name: Controlled Burst
techniques.description: Trade mobility for a reliable two-shot attack sequence.

techniques.name: Armour Drill
techniques.description: Prepare the next hit to ignore part of armour.

name: Defender
description: Brace applies Guarded for two phases, trading mobility for staying power.

techniques.name: Interpose
techniques.description: Step into a line threatening a nearby ally and become Guarded alongside them.

techniques.name: Anchor Point
techniques.description: Brace in place, resisting pressure with extra armour this phase.

name: Scout
description: Surge refunds three action points and applies Quickened for one phase.

techniques.name: Slipstep
techniques.description: Move to a hazardous tile without triggering its landing effect.

techniques.name: Spotter's Mark
techniques.description: Mark a hostile so the next allied attack ignores its cover.

name: Medic
description: Field Dressing restores four vitality to an injured ally within four tiles.

techniques.name: Stabilise
techniques.description: Return an incapacitated ally to one vitality without restoring their actions.

techniques.name: Combat Stimulant
techniques.description: Give an ally two action points now, then leave them Hindered for two phases.

name: Engineer
description: Shock Drone deals three direct damage to a hostile within four tiles.

techniques.name: Portable Cover
techniques.description: Place destructible directional cover on an empty tile beside the engineer.

techniques.name: Overcharge
techniques.description: Prime the next carried equipment action for a stronger one-round result.

name: Psionic
description: Neural Disrupt hinders a hostile's accuracy for one phase at range five.

techniques.name: Kinetic Draw
techniques.description: Pull a hostile one validated tile toward the psionic without passing through blockers.

techniques.name: Premonition
techniques.description: Read a hostile's next intent and soften its accuracy for the coming phase.

name: Biotech Specialist
description: Spore Ward grants the entire active squad regeneration for two phases.

techniques.name: Adaptive Secretion
techniques.description: Give an ally resistance to the nearest visible hazard for one phase.

techniques.name: Spore Veil
techniques.description: Create a short-lived obscuring field with a clear one-tile boundary.

name: Breacher
description: Make an Entrance crosses a short route, breaks a target, and opens a clear firing lane.

name: Fortifier
description: Raise Bastion deploys temporary directional cover for a colonist or mission asset.

name: Rescue Specialist
description: Carry Through pulls an ally toward safety, restores one or two vitality, and guards both colonists.

name: Chorus Warden
description: Borrowed Weather converts a nearby faction hazard into a brief neutral field that shares regeneration at a personal cost.

name: Vanguard
description: Hold the Line guards every ally within two tiles for two phases.

name: Pathfinder
description: Ghost Vector refunds two action points, then applies Quickened and Focused.

name: Lifewright
description: Vital Cascade heals three vitality and grants two phases of regeneration at range five.

name: Null Adept
description: Null Lance deals two direct damage and disrupts a hostile for two phases at range six.
